title: C4OS Grill Question 002A - Tauri Tool Authority Boundary

questions.label: What does it mean for a Tauri tool to be dormant but available?
questions.help: Recommended: tools are registered in the Tauri backend but require a C4OS app-shell or app-plugin enablement record before any user-impacting invocation. This keeps the backend robust while making plugin enablement enforceable.
options: Registered backend tool, blocked until app shell or enabled app plugin grants access
Registered backend tool, callable by any enabled app plugin that declares the tool
Registered backend tool, callable by frontend if Tauri permission allows it

questions.label: Notes or corrections
questions.help: Clarify whether app plugins declare desired tools, whether users approve tool access per plugin, and whether disabled plugins can ever call dormant tools.
